title: Seek help! Material requirements split purchase orders through different suppliers

posts.cooked: Since the BOM is composed of materials provided by different suppliers, how to split the purchase order according to different suppliers when the new construction material is required? Thank you!

posts.name: szufisher
posts.cooked:
this the code extracted from my app for your kind reference.

def split_mr_by_default_supplier(doc, method):
    if (doc.material_request_type == 'Purchase' and 
        frappe.db.get_singles_value("Stock Settings", 'split_mr_by_default_supplier')
        and not doc.flags.split_mr):
        item_code_list = {item.item_code for item in doc.items}
        
        item = frappe.qb.DocType('Item')
        item_default = frappe.qb.DocType('Item Default')

        item_default_list = frappe.qb.from_(item
        ).left_join(item_default
        ).on(
            (item.name == item_default.parent) &
            (item_default.company == doc.company) &
            (item_default.parenttype == 'Item')
        ).where(
            item.name.isin(item_code_list)
        ).select(
            item.name.as_('parent'),
            item_default.default_supplier
        ).run(as_dict=1)
        
        supplier_item_map = {}
        first_mr_item_list = []
        for item_default in item_default_list:
            # or '' 处理 None 和 '' 并存的情况
            item_list = supplier_item_map.setdefault(item_default.default_supplier or '', set()) # or 
            item_list.add(item_default.parent)

        if len(supplier_item_map) > 1:
            for i, (supplier, item_list) in enumerate(supplier_item_map.items()):
                if not i:
                    first_supplier,first_mr_item_list = (supplier, item_list)
                    doc.zelin_supplier = first_supplier                
                else:
                    new_mr = frappe.copy_doc(doc, ignore_no_copy=False)
                    new_mr.zelin_supplier = supplier
                    new_mr.flags.split_mr = True
                    new_mr.items = [row for row in doc.items if row.item_code in item_list]
                    new_mr.insert()
                    if doc.docstatus == 1: new_mr.submit()
            if first_mr_item_list:
                doc.items = [row for row in doc.items if row.item_code in first_mr_item_list]
            frappe.msgprint("已按物料默认供应商拆单")

split_mr_by_default_supplier is a custom field in Stock Settings which control whether this feature is active or not.
